function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents for a regular expression and return matching lines with file path and line number. Bounded search: at most 200 matches, 2000 entries, 8 MiB input and 5 seconds; skips symlinks, large/binary files and very long lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression to search for.

path.description: Directory or file to search in. Defaults to the workspace root.
